5. Account menu shows the email and Logout

specs.title: TC-03: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket
2. Plus on product A
3. Minus on product A
4. Minus on product A at quantity 1
5. Remove product A

specs.title: TC-04: Purchase limit for one product

steps.title: 1. Add the product from the product list
2. Increase the quantity to 5
3. Increase the quantity over the limit
4. Read the basket
5. Add the product from the product list again

specs.title: TC-05: Valid coupon on the payment step

steps.title: 1. Checkout from the basket
2. Select the saved address
3. Select One Day Delivery
4. Redeem the coupon of the current month
5. Select the saved card and continue

specs.title: TC-06: Invalid coupon and expired coupon

steps.title: 1. Checkout and select the saved address
2. Select One Day Delivery
3. Redeem an invalid code
4. Redeem the coupon of the previous month
5. Select the saved card and continue

specs.title: TC-07: Order with a card, from basket to order history

steps.title: 1. Add the products from the product list
2. Open the basket
3. Checkout and select the saved address
4. Select One Day Delivery
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and continue
7. Place the order
8. Read the order summary on the confirmation page
9. The basket is empty
10. Order History shows the order
